text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement an accessible loading zone adjacent to No. 42 Barker Avenue, located on the west side of Binswood Avenue. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access for Wheel-Trans and accessible permit holders, and will not result in the loss of any permit parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the west side of Binswood Avenue, between a point 15 metres north of Barker Avenue and a point 11 metres further north. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Binswood Avenue, between Barker Avenue and Holborne Avenue, to be in effect from a point 26 metres north of Barker Avenue and Holborne Avenue.
